# Buildroot users table (manual, "Makeusers syntax"):
# username uid group gid password home shell groups comment
# The owner's login, present in every image, slot and reinstall; "=" = plain
# text password, hashed at build time. "sudo" group: rule enabled by the sudo
# package (%sudo ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL).
